results.description:
ianacare is for family caregivers: anyone caring for a parent, spouse, child, or other loved one living with a chronic or serious illness, including dementia.

Caring for someone you love isn't the problem — it's figuring out the unknowns. ianacare helps you get answers, make a plan, and keep track of it all, with real human support behind every step for eligible programs.

Anyone can access iana, Action Plans, the care log, and family coordination, on your phone or computer. If ianacare comes through your employer or the Medicare GUIDE program, you may also have a Care Navigator and additional resources (see below).

CHAT WITH IANA™, YOUR AI CARE COMPANION
Caregiving doesn't have office hours. Ask iana about managing care around a new diagnosis, a difficult behavior, or what to ask the doctor tomorrow, and iana can help you think it through. iana is built on ianacare's I Am Not Alone Care Model, shaped by 50,000+ family journeys, and remembers your situation so you don't have to start over.

KNOW WHAT TO DO NEXT
Answer a few questions about where things stand today, and iana builds your Action Plan: a personalized, prioritized list of next steps with vetted resources and support options. It updates as your situation changes, so it's never a generic checklist.

KEEP TRACK OF THE DAY-TO-DAY
Quick Log captures care notes in a few taps — in the waiting room, the parking lot, or the kitchen at 6 a.m. Care Log History keeps every note and iana chat in one searchable place, and iana can summarize it before an appointment so you walk in prepared.

BRING IN FAMILY & FRIENDS, IF YOU WANT TO
Caring on your own? Everything above works for you. If others want to help, invite them to coordinate meals, rides, and tasks without the group text.

THROUGH YOUR EMPLOYER
If ianacare is a benefit at your work, you also get a Care Navigator, a trained caregiving expert you can message or schedule a call with. You'll also find benefits your employer offers, live events and support groups, and practical articles on the Community Hub. 

THROUGH THE MEDICARE GUIDE PROGRAM
The Medicare GUIDE program supports people living with dementia and the family members who care for them. If ianacare is your GUIDE provider, you may also have a dedicated Care Navigator, dementia-specific support, help arranging rest breaks (respite care), live events and support groups, and the Community Hub. If your Care Navigator is through another GUIDE provider, ianacare adds iana, tailored resources, and live events alongside that support. 

PRIVATE AND SECURE
ianacare follows HIPAA standards to protect your health information, and your data is encrypted to keep it safe. Your information is never sold or used for advertising, and you choose who on your team can see it.

IMPORTANT
iana is an AI, not a substitute for professional medical or mental health advice. Always talk with your care team about medical decisions. In a medical emergency, call 911. If you're in crisis, call or text 988.

Terms of Use: https://ianacare.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://ianacare.com/privacy-policy/

One place to coordinate help, communicate updates & receive emotional support. Schedule meal deliveries, rides to appointments, and visiting hours by posting tasks others can help with. Notify all concerned family members, friends, and community members about the status of your loved one with a single message. Connect with your support network with posts like photos and well wishes.

ORGANIZE HELP
Coordinate meaningful help (meals, rides, visits) when you most need it. Make it easier for people to help in even the smallest ways, and save time communicating unmet needs.

UPDATE EVERYONE
Share updates with your friends & family instead of sending multiple emails, phone calls or texts.

FEEL CONNECTED
Allow friends & family to express love, emotional support, and uplifting messages. 

How to coordinate help while caring for a loved one:

1. Create a Lotsa Community.
2. Invite family, friends, neighbors & colleagues to help with your Community.
3. Add tasks to the feed, such as meal deliveries, so friends can volunteer.
4. Keep everyone updated through personal blogs, photos, and well wishes.

results.description:
RecallCue turns an iPad into an easy to read Day Clock for dementia and memory loss. Caregivers can send reminders, photos, messages, and video check-ins from their phone, from anywhere.

Built for seniors and people experiencing memory decline, early stage dementia, or Alzheimer’s, and for the family members and care teams supporting them.

HOW IT WORKS
RecallCue is a two device setup:
1) iPad for your loved one: a hands off Day Clock that’s simple to read and use
2) iPhone for the caregiver: manage reminders and connection remotely

WHY FAMILIES USE RECALLCUE
- Helps reduce confusion about what day it is and what’s coming next
- Creates calm, predictable routines with reminders and schedules
- Makes it easier to stay connected even when you can’t be there in person

THE DEMENTIA FRIENDLY DAY CLOCK
- Clear display of day, date, time, and time of day (morning, afternoon, evening)
- Simple agenda view so today’s plan is always visible
- Large, high contrast design with adjustable settings
- Multiple languages supported
- Analog or digital clock options, plus 12 or 24 hour time format

CAREGIVER TOOLS
Reminders and alarms
- Set one time or recurring reminders for routines, meals, appointments, and more

Messages and photos
- Send a message or photo that appears on the iPad to create comfort and connection

Two way video calls
- Call for a quick check-in, with optional auto answer settings to make it easier

Music
- Play familiar music and playlists to support a calming routine

Documents and files
- Upload and organize important information so it’s easy to access when it matters

Albums
- Create photo albums and schedule when images display on the iPad

SUBSCRIPTION AND FREE TRIAL
Available as a monthly or annual subscription with no long term commitment. Download today to unlock a week of free access.

NEED HELP
Email: support@recallcue.com

DISCLAIMER
RecallCue is not intended to cure dementia or mild cognitive impairment (MCI). It’s designed to support quality of life, daily orientation, and family communication.

Nationally known dementia experts have created this app as a resource and guide for persons with dementia, families and caregivers.  

The dementia guide offers helpful advice and support as you travel through each stage of the dementia experience. Our approach is dementia positive and our goal is to improve the quality of life of persons with dementia, families and caregivers.  

As you travel through the dementia experience our App provides a “Dementia Guide” to help you understand dementia, offers management tips and provides access (links) to information and resources for living with dementia. 

Our goal is to directly educate and empower all older adults, persons with dementia, families and caregivers while guiding them through the dementia journey.

Stimulate your memory and have fun with memory senior games. A complete collection of games that will help you develop your memory skills while having fun.
Within this app you will find different games to test your capacity of retention and memory in the short and long term.

Each game has different levels so you can practice gradually. In addition, you can see the score obtained in each level and visualize your progress. Ideal to stimulate the memory of older people.

TYPES OF GAMES

- Find card pairs
- Repeat sequences
- Avoid obstacles and trace the right path
- Remember figures and numbers
- Memorize patterns
- Associate objects
- Memorize elements of different images
- Distractive games to stimulate working memory


APP FEATURES

- Daily memory training
- Available in 5 languages
- Simple and intuitive interface
- Different levels for all ages
- Constant updates with new games

COGNITIVE STIMULATION

Senior memory games belongs to a collection of games designed to stimulate different cognitive areas in adults: Memory, Attention, Processing speed, Visuospatial Function and Coordination.

The design of these games has been carried out in collaboration with experts in neuroscience and psychiatry, with the aim of creating playful content and, in addition, serve as a complement to the treatments carried out in health centers.


ABOUT TELLMEWOW

Tellmewow is a mobile game development company specialized in easy adaptation and basic usability which makes our games ideal for the elderly or young people who simply want to play an occasional game without major complications.

If you have any suggestions for improvement or want to stay tuned about upcoming games, follow us on our social networks.
